metadata.title: Green Toy Soldier on Pink Background

recipe.visualDefinition: A full-frame, eye-level shot of a single green plastic toy soldier, depicted as a female figure, standing on a textured pink surface against a solid pink background. The soldier is positioned slightly off-center to the right and occupies the lower portion of the frame, saluting. The background is a uniform, soft pink with subtle variations in tone, suggesting a studio setting.
coreVisualRelationships: The green toy soldier stands in stark color contrast against the pink background and foreground.
The small scale of the soldier is emphasized by the vast, empty pink space above it.
The textured pink foreground provides a grounded base for the smooth plastic soldier.
The soldier's pose (saluting) suggests a narrative of respect or command within a playful context.
coreInvariants: A single green plastic toy soldier, female in form, must be present.
The soldier must be in a saluting pose.
The background and foreground must be predominantly pink.
The soldier must be positioned in the lower third of the image, slightly off-center to the right.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The toy soldier is positioned in the lower-right quadrant of the image, occupying approximately 15-20% of the vertical height and 10% of the horizontal width. Its small scale is emphasized by the large expanse of empty space above.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The green toy soldier serves as the primary visual anchor due to its contrasting color and distinct form against the uniform pink.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye is immediately drawn to the green soldier due to its isolation and color contrast. There is no strong implied movement, but the saluting pose directs attention upwards and slightly to the left, into the empty pink space.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The vast majority of the image (approximately 80%) is negative space, consisting of the solid pink background. This amplifies the presence and isolation of the small toy soldier.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: The dominant color is a soft, medium pink, forming the background and foreground, creating a minimalist and somewhat whimsical atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: The vibrant green of the toy soldier acts as the primary contrast color, making the subject stand out sharply against the pink.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: There are no distinct accent colors beyond the dominant pink and contrasting green.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: The pink background is moderately saturated with a medium-light value, while the green soldier is highly saturated with a medium-dark value, creating a clear distinction. The pink foreground has a slightly darker value and more texture than the background.
paletteRestrictions: Only shades of pink and green should be used.
No other strong colors should be introduced.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a minimalist studio shot with a solid, soft pink background and a slightly darker, textured pink foreground. The foreground should occupy the bottom 20-25% of the image. Ensure the pink tones are consistent but allow for subtle, soft variations in the background to suggest depth.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a single green plastic toy soldier, depicted as a female figure in a saluting pose, in the lower-right quadrant of the image. The soldier should stand on the textured pink foreground. Ensure the soldier is sharply in focus and well-lit, casting a subtle shadow if appropriate for realism.

verificationChecks: Is the background a uniform, soft pink?
Is the foreground a textured pink surface?
Is there a single green toy soldier (female) in a saluting pose?
Is the soldier positioned in the lower-right quadrant?
Does the soldier contrast sharply with the pink background?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of pink for background and foreground
Texture intensity of the pink foreground
Exact position of the toy soldier (within the lower-right quadrant)
Lighting direction and intensity on the soldier
Subtle variations in the pink background to suggest depth or softness

mustAchieve: Clear visual separation between the green soldier and the pink environment.
The toy soldier must be the undisputed focal point.
avoid: Distracting elements in the background or foreground.
Poor lighting that obscures details of the soldier.

postGenerationChecks: Verify the presence and correct pose of the female green toy soldier.
Confirm the pink color scheme for both background and foreground.
Ensure the soldier is the primary and isolated subject.
Check for appropriate scale and positioning of the soldier within the frame.
Assess the overall cleanliness and minimalism of the composition.
recipe.reuseFormula: Generate a minimalist studio image with a soft pink background and a textured pink foreground. Place a single, sharply focused green plastic female toy soldier, in a saluting pose, in the lower-right quadrant of the frame. The soldier should be the sole subject and stand out clearly against the pink.
